objective: A colour of its own for the project role (turquoise, Q93), with a thicker outline, so that the repositories of a folder of several read apart at a glance.
summary: The project role has its own colour, turquoise (Q93, chosen by the human from screenshots), mixed at 55% with the text colour to keep 3:1 in light themes, and a 2 px outline on its boxes, groups and frames; tokens in tokens.css. Accessibility 191/191 in the six themes, webview tests, lint, typecheck and format pass. Recorded in PLAN.md, ADR 0072 and the 0.1.2 changelog. Not committed.
